headings.usage: All page titles, card headers, and modal titles. Use tight tracking (-0.02em).

body.usage: General text, form labels, table data. Excellent legibility at small sizes.

dashboard_grid.description: Control Room Grid - Dense but breathable

form_builder.description: Canvas Layout - Center stage with sidebars

instructions_to_main_agent: Use 'Outfit' font for all headings and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for body text. Import them via Google Fonts in index.css.
Implement the 'Control Room' grid for the main dashboard.
Use the 'Canvas Layout' for the Form Builder page.
Apply the 'Vibrant' color palette. Use Violet-600 as the primary brand color.
Ensure all interactive elements have hover states and transitions (duration-200).
For the Form Builder, use a dot-grid background to emphasize the 'builder' context.
Ensure all inputs and buttons have 'rounded-lg' (not default md) for a modern feel.
universal_guidelines: Do not use generic centered layouts.
Create depth through layered design elements.
Use glass-morphism effects where appropriate (e.g., sticky headers).
Never use 'transition: all'. Animate specific properties.
Always use modern button styles (pill or rounded-lg).
